Time Unit Converter

Fast tools that run in your browser. No login, no sign-up.

Everything runs in your browser. Your text and files are not uploaded to our servers. No account or login is needed.

How to use

  1. Enter the value you want to convert.
  2. Choose the unit it is in (From) and the unit you want (To).
  3. Read the result, which updates as you type, and press Copy to keep it.

About this tool

Converts between milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, days and weeks. Months and years are left out on purpose because their length varies. A day is counted as exactly 24 hours and a week as exactly 7 days.

Frequently asked questions

How accurate are the results?

Conversions use the exact definition of each unit and show up to 10 significant digits, so tiny floating-point errors do not appear.

Why are months and years missing?

They vary in length, from 28 to 31 days and 365 or 366 days, so no fixed conversion is correct. Days and weeks are exact.

Is my data uploaded or stored?

No. The tool runs in your browser, so what you enter stays on your device and is not stored by us. The only exception is the standard server log kept by the hosting provider, described in the Privacy Policy.
